test.title: 超现实亲子时尚大片
test.test_input: Test subjects are wholly fictional adults: father aged 50, mother aged 48, and their adult daughter aged 22. Choose denim for the mother jacket.
test.adaptation: ChatGPT适配测试，非原指定模型实测
changes: 填充虚构父50/母48/成年女儿22岁，母亲夹克选择原文denim分支。
test.selected_source_prompt:
Ultra-realistic family fashion infographic photography featuring a Father, Mother, and Daughter in coordinated casual outfits, arranged in a balanced circular exploded composition.
Floating elements organized clockwise around the trio:
• Father: neutral baseball cap, classic wristwatch, cotton crew-neck tee, lightweight casual jacket, tailored denim jeans, leather belt, ankle socks, white sneakers.
• Mother: soft knit hat, minimal gold earrings, relaxed-fit cotton top, cropped denim or linen jacket, high-waist jeans, leather belt, clean sneakers, structured mini handbag.
• Daughter: playful hair accessories, soft cotton tee, light denim jacket, stretch jeans, ankle socks, pastel sneakers, mini backpack.
Each clothing item suspended mid-air with fine dotted guide lines connecting back to each family member.
Minimal editorial labels highlighting fabric, color, and material details (cotton, denim, leather, rubber sole).
Clean studio background with subtle gradient.
Soft diffused lighting for a warm, wholesome mood.
Premium lifestyle editorial styling, ultra-sharp focus, natural skin tones, 8K quality, high-end fashion catalog aesthetic.
